answer: Profile resource consumption: each agent's pattern of CPU, memory, and network use forms a forge of traces unique to its workload. A real agent's usage rises and falls with its tasks, while a thousand Sybils idle identically, showing the same flat line. An atlas of these profiles lets the network cluster identical consumption and treat the cluster as one operator. Identical usage across many identities — marble-smooth and flat — is the signature of a script, not of independent agents. To differ, each fake must consume resources in a distinct pattern, which means doing genuinely distinct work.
